output.message: I agree with Agents D1, D3, and D5: operating deterioration supports Sell, but missing valuation, liquidity, and funding-runway data make Strong Sell premature. Prioritize customer churn, organic revenue quality, R&D-to-revenue trends, and operating cash flow. Reconsider if core demand stabilizes and AI initiatives demonstrate commercial returns rather than headline momentum.
output.thought: The supplied information indicates weakening core software demand and declining client confidence, while unsustainable growth strategies and unusually high R&D spending raise concerns about revenue quality and future profitability. Partnership and AI announcements do not establish commercial success without measurable revenue, margins, or cash generation. No verified financial statements, valuation metrics, or detailed news evidence are provided, limiting assessment of downside severity.
